401 Unauthorized for reranking with invalid API key

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import RerankRequest
from liter_llm import AuthenticationError, Error

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        request = RerankRequest.from_json("{\"documents\":[\"doc1\"],\"model\":\"rerank-v3.5\",\"query\":\"test\"}")
        await client.rerank(request)
    except AuthenticationError as error:
        print(f"AuthenticationError: {error}")
    except Error as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
